status.defaultPrompt: Every day at 10 AM, search for the latest AI news and write a short report with the key insights. (Use the /cron skill to create a scheduled task in mu.)

confirmDeleteWithConversations: Delete this scheduled task? Its conversations will be deleted too.

detail.executionModeDescriptionNew: Each run starts a fresh conversation, so earlier context doesn't carry over. Best for recurring reports or checks that should stay independent.
detail.executionModeDescriptionExisting: Each run continues in the same conversation, so earlier context and results stay available. Best for follow-up tasks that build on previous runs.

page.description: Run tasks on a schedule. You can also ask mu in any conversation to create one for you.
page.awakeBanner: Scheduled tasks only run while your computer is awake.
page.keepAwakeTooltip: Keeps your computer from sleeping so scheduled tasks can run
page.scheduleHint: Each run starts after a random delay of a few minutes to spread server load.
page.customCronWarning: This task has a custom schedule that can't be edited here. Changing the frequency will replace it.

form.queueHint: When on, a run is skipped if the previous one is still running, so the assistant isn't interrupted.
